scope: One new staged current-H head/oral GPU test after forehead/iris/return priorities. Exactly4 verified mesh assets; no rejected historical eyes, no new eye/support/patch replacement, no production/sharedrig promotion.
latestSelectedScenePolicy: Viewer owns the latest selected base scene. Preserve its actual current materials and all recent eye/support/forehead/iris work; update binding provenance if its paths change.
sourceCompatibilityEvidence: Viewer read-only extraction confirms current four renderers still directly use original073e FBX; no head topology/UV/cut edits. New eyes, support and temporal interface patch are separate.
attachmentRule: Keep each existing source node and every parent TRS unchanged. Add child at local position0, rotationidentity, scale.0001, and put the saved mesh on a new bone-free SKMR child. Disable only its original renderer. Do not apply frozen audit world matrix directly; current parent hierarchy supplies current registration/animation. Never multiply morph weights by10000.
exclusions: All Ren_H_Eye_* historical renderers and all8 saved historical eye/lash meshes
Both saved hair assets; current hair/cap/Head/CapSocket remain intact
Current NeutralDesignerEyes/DesignerEyeRegistration hierarchy and all recent eye/iris materials
Current supportv2/forehead material partition and temporal interface patch
Static teeth/ear/jewelry/cap/support meshes and all parent transforms
Existing historical source scenes, source FBX/import settings, saved measured mesh assets

weights.headAndInnerWall: Set jawOpen_A=100*a; mouthSeal=100*s*(1-a). Ordered indices0/1 must be verified by name/frameWeight.
weights.staticTeeth: retain source renderer and transform; no invented jaw transform
weights.eyeInterfacePatch: Current patch audit establishes canonical jawOpen_A and mouthSeal deltas are zero (shapes may be omitted by importer). Preserve it and all current eye geometry/attachments; do not add old eye controls.

materials.rule: Retain actual donor sharedMaterials in identical submesh order, shader variants, texture hashes/ST, render-state and graphic masks. Update review.Head renderer reference to new head child while leaving FaceFrame and source-node hierarchy unchanged.
materials.headSlots: Three existing skin/cheek slots; primary ArtistRose slot alone has closed-lip endpoint maps. Never apply face atlas using another UV.
materials.closedPaintFormula: t=clamp(a/.75,0,1); _ClosedWeight=1-t*t*(3-2*t) on existing closed-endpoint slot(s), zero elsewhere. Preserve existing _BaseMap/_ShadowMap/_ClosedBaseMap/_ClosedShadowMap and control map references/ST.
materials.runtimeOrdering: RenDesignerEyeReview.Awake clones materials; refinement controllers can swap shader variants. Bind after those initializations or use per-slot property blocks for only _ClosedWeight, preserving all existing properties. Do not mutate shared .mat assets.
materials.oral: Retain current two-sided _Cull0 cavity/tongue materials; existing static enamel stays attached.
materials.unsupportedExpressions: This test only varies A+seal; no smile/pucker/funnel/performance controls or new language coverage claim.

preflight: Verify exact4 saved mesh SHA hashes and persistence report; reject unknown/extraneous asset names.
Verify current source FBX073e hash, direct mesh source identities and bone-free renderers. If head topology/UV/cuts changed, stop this swap and transfer canonical deltas to that exact later source.

Compare rendered Basis triangle corners/submesh material association and UVs between current imported mesh and saved scaled mesh with inverse attachment; imported vertex counts can differ because saved copy used weldfalse. Do not require equal vertex ordinals or silently remap by nearest point.
Preserve all old source-node TRS; recompute native frame from existing Head axis markers for checks. Do not substitute audit world transform into the live scene.
Freeze hashes/corners/transforms of current eyes/support/interface patch before and after; only4 old renderers disabled and4 replacement children added.
Rebind only current head/oral consumers to the4 new SKMRs; check default A0/seal100 and cavity/tongueA0 before capture. Old rejected eyes remain disabled, old outline shell remains off.

gpuTest.scopes: Use actual Windows GPU player after current visual priorities; no repeat14mesh280pose CPU sweep absent new failure.
gpuTest.lighting: Keep selected neutral lighting, camera, cap/hair and latest eye/support/iris state fixed across all poses.
recordEachCapture: semantic a/s and actual per-renderer blendshape names/weights
closed paint weight and actual map/material hashes
enabled replacement/disabled original and rejected-eye status
frame index, graphics API, screenshot dimensions/path/hash
visualReview: Check lip contour/paint follows opening without rose smearing or doubled surfaces
Check wall/cavity/tongue remain continuous and two-sided with static teeth in place
Check latest eye silhouette, temporal interface patch and forehead/support remain unchanged at every mouth pose
Check final return-closed matches initialclosed with identical camera/lighting and no retained open weights

limits: Tolerance-qualified position fidelity only:161 tiny nonzero rows zeroed across the full14mesh diagnostic; no above-tolerance loss. Current four meshes are a dense prototype, not40k-triangle/game-ready. GPU test pending, canonical female sharedrig binding remains separate.
